name: vietfood-delivery-fullstack
description: Fullstack Food Ordering App with Supabase PostgreSQL, Real-time Chat, Admin Portal & PWA

scripts.install:all: cmd /c "cd server && npm install" && cmd /c "cd client && npm install"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.commit: git add . && git commit -m "chore: auto commit updates" && git push
scripts.deploy: git add . && git commit -m "deploy: update app" && git push
